findings.message: The org/project parse covers `<org>/<project>/_git/<repo>` and the legacy `.visualstudio.com` form. It still misses the project-less Azure DevOps clone URL, where the project is implied by the repo name: `https://dev.azure.com/<org>/_git/<repo>` and `https://<org>.visualstudio.com/_git/<repo>`. Those URLs fall through silently to the shared secret's org and project, which is the defect class this change fixes. Add a branch for the project-less form (org from the URL, project = repo name) and add table rows for both hosts. If those clone URLs are deliberately unsupported, make the pod warn instead of staying silent.
findings.scenario: FLEET_REPO_URL=https://dev.azure.com/acme/_git/proj -> neither regex matches, so AZDO_ORG/AZDO_PROJECT keep the fleet-azdo secret's values (e.g. other-org/other-proj) and the draft PR is created in the wrong project, with no warning.
